source_policy.filing_derived: Potential evidence type only; this implementation does not classify any reference as matchable. No source observation may issue a decision until source bytes, locator, entity/context/dimensions, period, exact unit, finite value/domain, publication rights, and intended use are independently verified.
source_policy.external_price_yield_rating: Potential evidence type only; no external observation can be matched by this implementation. Require source-authentic quote/instrument/rating identity, context, period/as-of date, exact unit, finite value/domain, rights, and purpose verification before review.
source_policy.analyst_assumption: Requires separately approved issuer-specific rationale and explicit alternatives/sensitivity; never infer from historical facts, industry comparators, or another issuer's scenario.
source_policy.lookup_route: Requires independently verified issuer classification or route evidence and validated lookup semantics; workbook lookup outputs are not observations.
source_policy.formula: Never supply formula outputs as direct inputs. Guarded formula exceptions remain inactive pending separate verified transformation authorization.
source_policy.alternatives: No numeric default. Alternative is abstain pending evidence or an explicit analyst-approved policy; no other-issuer scenario value is an issuer-neutral default.
source_policy.uncertainty: Unresolved unless a unique compatible source observation exists; missing, duplicate, conflicting, stale, dimensionally mismatched, or insufficiently identified evidence abstains.

selector_domain_policy.source: pinned workbook validation formulas and referenced lookup cells
selector_domain_policy.issuer_specific_decisions: none; route choice requires independently verified issuer evidence and analyst approval
selector_domain_policy.cross_issuer: never copy a selector choice or issuer-specific route from another issuer; abstain when issuer evidence is absent
selector_domain_policy.mutation: domains are not authentic unless the whole workbook SHA-256 matches the pinned contract
selector_domain_policy.alternatives: all listed validation choices are workbook-supported choices, not defaults; absent issuer-specific evidence, abstain
selector_domain_policy.limitations: inline lists and unresolved or unsupported validation formulas do not establish a domain
